featured_reviews.name: Sarah Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Jaffer Bhai’s Delhi Darbar Catering Service (Dongri/Sandhurst Road branch) with my mother on the first day of Ramadan to book their services, as they hold a monopoly at Medallion Hall. We have a Haldi function on the third day of Eid, so we were already short on time and had no other options due to this monopoly system.
As soon as we arrived, the manager made a rude comment to his colleagues saying, “Agae Ramadan me uth kar,” which was completely unprofessional and disrespectful. We chose to ignore it and continued politely, asking for the food prices since we genuinely liked the Medallion Hall banquet for our small function.
When I requested a pen and paper to note down the prices, he again reacted rudely. While stepping out, he commented sarcastically, “Ab pen aur paper chahiye.” This kind of behavior toward customers is unacceptable. We were not asking for free food! we were there to book and pay for your “unprofessional” service.
If you do not have the time or basic courtesy to attend to customers properly, then perhaps reconsider holding monopolies in banquet halls just to increase business. Customers deserve respect.
Because of this experience, we decided not to opt for Medallion Hall (Charni Road), even though we genuinely liked the venue. There are far better and more respectful options available in the market such as Shalimar Restaurant and Persian Darbar etc.
From today onwards, my entire family and I have decided to boycott Delhi Darbar Caterers and their restaurants.
Extremely disappointed. 0 stars.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We liked the banquet..

When we visited the delhi darbar branch at Sandhurst road branch the manager over there didn't seem to be interested to speak to us...
One thing was he said - "aa jate hai uthke ramadan mein"
The other - "apke bohot kum log hai"
Let me tell you, we pay for each and every plate,it doesn't matter if it's 70 or 7000 people, you people charge for every plate...
Try to learn customer service..
Surely not recommended until this monopoly is there...

From the moment we booked the venue, the event coordinator was incredibly helpful, guiding us through the planning process and offering valuable insights. The banquet hall’s flexibility in accommodating our specific needs, from catering preferences to seating arrangements, truly stood out.

The culinary experience was outstanding. The menu offered a delightful variety, and the chef’s expertise was evident in the delectable dishes served. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about the quality of the food, and the service staff ensured that everyone’s needs were promptly attended to.

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
MCA Lounge - A Delightful Experience at Wankhede Stadium

I recently had the pleasure of visiting MCA Lounge, located within the iconic premises of Wankhede Stadium. This was my first time attending an event here, and it turned out to be an incredible experience.

The food was nothing short of excellent – every dish was thoughtfully prepared and bursting with flavor. The quality and presentation of the meals truly elevated the entire experience.

The ambiance of the lounge, combined with its unique location at Wankhede, added a special charm to the event. It’s not every day that you get to enjoy great food with a backdrop of one of India’s most legendary cricket stadiums!

Whether you're attending an event or simply dining, MCA Lounge is a fantastic place to indulge in a memorable culinary experience.

featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
MVM Banquets is a good place for hosting small functions and its location is truly superb. The hall is convenient and easy for guests to reach. The only challenge is that no parking is available, so visitors need to park on the road. One important point for anyone planning to book is to cross check all details in advance. Decoration and catering may have monopoly arrangements and the real cost can sometimes be hidden in these services rather than in the rent of the venue. Overall it is a nice place, just make sure to confirm everything before finalising your booking.

featured_reviews.name: Juzar Mustan
featured_reviews.review_text:

Overall, they are responsive and do their best to accommodate special requests.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Farhan Ariwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
The catering staff and all others employed during the function are absolutely outstanding. So is the food and decorations.
However, the people incharge of the hall, that is the manager and decorator are nothing short but liars. They made a quotation to us with various promises, and when the time came for our event, everything was changed. They even changed the menu we decided, just so that it is easier on them. Worst of all, they acted like everything was our fault, and refused to take any accountability. Purely despicable. I hope the owners see this review.

featured_reviews.name: Shardul Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our even on June 1, 2024 at MVM. We had a wonderful time. The food was delicious and all had a great time.

featured_reviews.name: Vimarsha Ramesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended one of my friends wedding here and my friend and their family faced following issues.
1) charged us for speakers even though it was never mentioned before.
2) the speaker and projector they gave didn't work properly, and the staff who was attending it couldn't help us. Didn't have a normal audio jack to connect our laptop to the speakers.
3) changed the menu from what we decided, and refusing to accept they did it on their own.
4) there were broken glass in the venue, which we saw like 2/3 weeks before, and they promised to get it fixed before our function. Which they didn't.
4) refusing to give our deposit back.
5) harassing us by continuously calling us, even though we told them, since you have cameras, share the video with us we'll have a look and see. If it's extra people, we will definitely pay. But they're just telling we need to pay.
6) the original quotation they gave us, and what we finally ended up actually paying, were vastly different.

featured_reviews.name: Saili Amberkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of booking MVM BANQUETS for my wedding, and I can't praise it enough. The team was incredibly professional and accommodating, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned and executed. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and there was more than enough to satisfy all our guests. We received numerous compliments on the meal, which made the day even more special.

The interiors of the banquet hall are stunning, with elegant and tasteful decor that created the perfect ambiance for our celebration. The decor team did an exceptional job, transforming the space into a fairy tale setting that exceeded our expectations.

A special mention goes to Sandeep and Nishita, whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable. Sandeep was incredibly attentive to every detail, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and seamlessly. His professionalism and dedication were evident in every interaction. Nishita's creative touch and impeccable taste added a unique flair to our event, making the ambiance truly magical.

Also, Nitin and Mohit were incredibly attentive and responsive, addressing all of our concerns and requests with professionalism and a genuine desire to make our day special.

Overall, MVM provided an unforgettable wedding experience. A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello All,

I recently had booked MVM BANQUETS for my wedding reception on 11th May 2024.

The entire staff / team were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity and every dish was beautifully presented to satisfy all our guests.

A special mention goes to Sandeep, Nishita, Nitin & Mohit whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable by serving the tasteful food and assisting all our guest wherever required.

A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!
